name: Before → After reveal (craft proof)

hook.visual: Ugly / incomplete / neglected state fills the frame immediately
hook.audio_or_vo: One-line setup or silent with hard SFX on the cut
hook.text_overlay: BEFORE — or a blunt label of the problem state
hook.pattern_interrupt: No preamble; the ‘before’ IS the thumb-stop

beats.visual: 3–5 quick process cuts specific to the niche (apply, install, train, cook, edit, transform)
beats.vo_or_copy: Optional sparse VO: time span or constraint

beats.visual: Hard cut or wipe to the finished result; hold 1.5–2s
beats.vo_or_copy: Silence or a single satisfied line

beats.visual: Detail insert that proves quality (texture, fit, UI, finish) then brand

cta.on_screen: See the full build / Get a quote
cta.spoken_or_caption: Want this for your [asset]? Start here.
cta.landing_promise: Gallery of similar before/afters matching the ad’s marque or job type

audio_design.music_energy: Build into the reveal; drop or swell on the after
audio_design.captions: BEFORE / AFTER labels mandatory; process labels optional

visual_system.camera: Same angle and framing for before and after whenever possible
visual_system.lighting: Match lighting between states so the craft is the variable
visual_system.color: Honest color; don’t fake the before darker than reality
visual_system.editing_pace: Fast process montage; hold the after

why_it_works: Transformation is the clearest value prop in visual niches
Matched framing makes the delta undeniable
Short runtime maximizes completion and replays
anti_patterns: Mismatched camera angles that invite skepticism
Overlong process that delays the payoff
Heavy VO that narrates the obvious
metrics_signals: Replays and scrub-back to the reveal

prompt_seeds.script: 15s silent-capable before/after. Matched framing. 4 process cuts. Hold after. One-line CTA.
prompt_seeds.shot_list: Before hold → process×4 → after hold → detail → end card
prompt_seeds.video_gen: Vertical transformation montage, matched framing before and after, documentary craft lighting

source_notes: Dominant pattern in restoration, reno, beauty, and cleaning verticals.
